purpose: Simulate a first-time Gen Z journey through changed mobile flows and report discoverability, comprehension, visual hierarchy, and interaction friction as testable hypotheses.
testOutcomes: A first-time tester can find the changed feature from its supported entry points and understand the next action at each step.
Primary actions, progress, results, and recovery feedback are clear on a mobile viewport.
Every reported issue includes steps, expected and actual behavior, mode, source state, severity, and sanitized evidence.
definitionOfDone: Run the assigned synthetic scenario on the stated build and viewport.
Report reproducible friction and record unverified hypotheses separately.
Retest assigned fixes and record pass, fail, or blocked with evidence.

subAgents.purpose: Check entry points, navigation, back behavior, and the first clear call to action without prior product knowledge.
Check the changed task's choices, progress, loading, completion feedback, and recovery from errors.
Check content readability at mobile size and any saved or shared output for completeness and privacy-safe presentation.

purpose: Simulate a customer seeking gentle emotional or relationship reflection across changed mobile flows and report trust, autonomy, safety-copy, privacy, and continuity issues using fictional inputs only.
testOutcomes: Guidance and reflection copy leave choices with the customer, without certain predictions or professional advice.
Sensitive inputs and saved content have understandable controls and do not appear in QA evidence.
Save, return, and follow-up paths explain their effects and recover clearly from failure.
definitionOfDone: Run the assigned fictional emotional-reflection scenario on the stated build and viewport.
Report reproducible friction and record unverified hypotheses separately.
Retest assigned fixes and record pass, fail, or blocked with evidence.

subAgents.purpose: Check agency-preserving language, appropriate symbolic framing, and support when a fictional prompt signals distress.
Check sensitive-input handling, save and return behavior, and follow-up expectations without exposing private content.

purpose: Simulate a deeper wisdom seeker using changed mobile flows for learning and continued reflection; report content depth, consistency, and continuity issues.
testOutcomes: Inputs, displayed content, and generated or saved outputs remain consistent across the changed flow.
A customer can explore deeper context and continue reflection without losing context or mistaking symbolic guidance for factual certainty.
Detail and learning surfaces support deliberate exploration with readable content and stable navigation.
definitionOfDone: Run the assigned synthetic learning-and-reflection scenario on the stated build and viewport.
Report reproducible friction and record unverified hypotheses separately.
Retest assigned fixes and record pass, fail, or blocked with evidence.

subAgents.purpose: Compare selected inputs, displayed details, output summaries, and saved content for consistency.
Check readable depth, detail navigation, and follow-up continuity in the changed flow.
